# flutter_iphone_duo_adapt

> Flutter package that makes an existing app iPhone Duo (Apple's foldable) ready: native hinge/fold bridge for iOS 27.1, retrofit widgets for bars and list/detail, fold-aware layout primitives, a desktop preview, a widget-test kit, a static audit, and an automatic code migration.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, usage, configuration, preview, testing, audit
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): step-by-step recipe for AI agents, JSON schemas, API map, invariants
- [Coverage](doc/coverage.md): Apple guidance mapped to package features; out-of-scope list
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Entry points

- `package:flutter_iphone_duo_adapt/iphone_duo_adapt.dart`: runtime widgets and `DuoLayoutInfo`
- `package:flutter_iphone_duo_adapt/testing.dart`: `pumpDuo`, `testDuoWidgets`, `DuoScenario`, `expectClearOfFold`, `expectInsideSafeArea`, `expectDuoGolden`
- `package:flutter_iphone_duo_adapt/audit.dart`: `DuoAuditor`, rules, JSON report
- `package:flutter_iphone_duo_adapt/migrate.dart`: `DuoMigrator`, migration steps

## Commands

- `dart run flutter_iphone_duo_adapt:duo_audit --json`
- `dart run flutter_iphone_duo_adapt:duo_audit --checklist`
- `dart run flutter_iphone_duo_adapt:duo_migrate --apply --json`
